rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God tells Muhammad to recount Abraham’s story to the people of Mecca.
rows.anchor: { واتل عليهم } على أهل مكة { نبأ } يعنى حديث { إبراهيم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks his father Azar and his people what they worship.
rows.anchor: { إذ قال لأبيه } آزر { وقومه ما تعبدون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They worship idols made of gold, silver, iron, copper, and wood, remaining devoted to them.
rows.anchor: من ذهب، وفضة، وحديد، ونحاس، وخشب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks whether the idols answer their prayers, benefit them when worshipped, or harm them if neglected.
rows.anchor: يقول: هل تجيبكم الأصنام إذا دعوتموهم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They defend worship by saying they found their fathers doing it; Abraham then asks about the idols worshipped by them and their earliest ancestors.
rows.anchor: يعنى هكذا يعبدون الأصنام { قال } إبراهيم:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham disavows the idols as enemies, but exempts the Lord of the worlds from that disavowal.
rows.anchor: أنا برىئ مما تعبدون، ثم استثنى إبراهيم عليه السلام مما يعبدون رب العالمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idolaters acknowledge that God created them and is their Lord, so Abraham does not disavow God.
rows.anchor: لأنهم يعلمون أن الله تعالى هو ربهم الذى خلقهم قوله: { إلا رب العالمين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham identifies the Creator as the one who guides him.
rows.anchor: الذي خلقني فهو يهدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God feeds Abraham when he is hungry and gives him drink when he is thirsty.
rows.anchor: إذا جعت { ويسقين } [آية: 79] إذا عطشت،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Abraham becomes ill, God heals him.
rows.anchor: وإذا مرضت فهو يشفين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God causes Abraham to die in this world and then raises him after death in the next life.
rows.anchor: بعد الموت فى الآخرة، { والذي أطمع } يعنى أرجو { أن يغفر لي خطيئتي يوم الدين } [آية: 82] يعنى يوم الحساب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham hopes God will forgive his sin on the Day of Judgment, meaning the Day of Reckoning, and worships only the one who does these things for him.
rows.anchor: يعنى أرجو { أن يغفر لي خطيئتي يوم الدين } [آية: 82] يعنى يوم الحساب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqatil identifies Abraham’s three lies as calling Sarah his sister, saying he was ill, and saying the great idol did it; one was for himself and two for God.
rows.anchor: وخطيئة إبراهيم ثلاث كذبات، حين قال عن سارة: هذه أختى، وحين قال: إنى سقيم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks for judgment, explained as understanding and knowledge, and to be joined with the prophets, who are the righteous.
rows.anchor: يعنى الفهم والعلم { وألحقني بالصالحين } [آية: 83] يعنى الأنبياء عليهم السلام،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He asks for lasting good praise among later people; God grants this, and people of every religion praise Abraham.
rows.anchor: يعنى ثناء حسنا يقال: من بعدى فى الناس،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks God to make him one of those who inherit the Garden of Bliss.
rows.anchor: يقول: اجعلنى ممن يرث الجنة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham’s father was among those astray, meaning the polytheists.
rows.anchor: يعنى من المشركين، { ولا تخزني } يعنى لا تعذبنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks not to be disgraced, meaning punished, on the day God raises creation after death.
rows.anchor: يعنى لا تعذبنى { يوم يبعثون } [آية: 87] يعنى يوم تبعث الخلق بعد الموت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After death, neither wealth nor children protect anyone from punishment.
rows.anchor: { يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون } [آية: 88] من العذاب من بعد الموت،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only one who comes to God sincere in monotheism, free of shirk, benefits on resurrection; wealth and offspring then benefit him.
rows.anchor: فى الآخرة { بقلب سليم } [آية: 89] من الشرك مخلصا لله عز وجل بالتوحيد،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon says he will verify the hoopoe’s report and asks whether it spoke truth or is a liar; Muqatil compares the plural address with 3:110.
rows.anchor: سننظر } فيما تقول، { أصدقت } فى قولك { أم كنت } يعنى أم أنت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hoopoe locates water near the ground when they camp; it directed Solomon’s party to water, so they dug wells and quenched their thirst.
rows.anchor: وكان الهدهد يدلهم على قرب الماء من الأرض إذا نزلوا، فدلهم على ماء، فنزلوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon sends his letter to the people of Sheba and tells the hoopoe to withdraw and watch what reply they make.
rows.anchor: وقال: { اذهب بكتابي هذا فألقه إليهم } يعنى إلى أهل سبأ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hoopoe carries the letter in its beak, drops it into the queen’s lap, and its seal makes her and her troops tremble and submit; Solomon’s authority was in his seal.
rows.anchor: فحمل الهدهد الكتاب بمنقاره، فطار حتى وقف على رأس المرأة، فرفرف ساعة والناس ينظرون،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen recognizes the messenger’s king as greater than her because a bird serves as his envoy.
rows.anchor: لأن ملك سليمان، عليه السلام، كان فى خاتمه فعرفوا أن الذى أرسل هذا الطير أعظم ملكا من ملكها،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen was Arab, from the people of Tubbaʿ ibn Abi Sharahil al-Himyari, and her people were Arabs of Tubbaʿ’s people.
rows.anchor: وكانت عربية من قوم تبع بن أبى شراحيل الحميرى، وقومها من قوم تبع، وهم عرب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The letter contained only the statement that it was from Solomon, the basmala, a prohibition against exalting themselves over him, and a demand to come submitting.
rows.anchor: فأخبرتهم بما فى الكتاب، ولم يكن فيه شىء غير: " إنه من سليمان، وإنه بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

rows.speaker: أبو صالح
rows.claim: Abu Salih reports that the letter was sealed.
rows.anchor: قال أبو صالح: ويقال: مختوم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen addresses her nobles and calls Solomon’s letter noble, meaning a fine or excellent letter.
rows.anchor: يعنى الأشراف، { إني ألقي إلي كتاب كريم } [آية: 29] يعنى كتاب حسن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She identifies the letter as from Solomon and notes its opening with the basmala.
rows.anchor: إنه من سليمان وإنه بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The letter tells them not to exalt themselves over Solomon and to come as Muslims.
rows.anchor: ألا تعلوا علي وأتوني مسلمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen reasons that if Solomon fights for worldly gain, they can supply it; if he fights for his Lord, he will neither seek nor accept anything except Islam.
rows.anchor: ثم قالت: إن يكن هذا الملك يقاتل على الدنيا، فإنا نمده بما أراد من الدنيا، وإن يكن يقاتل لربه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Her council consists of 313 commanders, each with a hundred thousand; she asks their advice and says she never decides until they attend.
rows.anchor: وهم: ثلاث مائة، وثلاثة عشر قائدا، مع كل مائة ألف، وهم أهل مشورتها،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who brings evil, meaning shirk, is cast face-first into the Fire, and its keepers say they are repaid only for their shirk.
rows.anchor: يعني بالشرك { فكبت وجوههم في النار } ثم تقول لهم خزنة جهنم:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord of this town is Mecca; God has forbidden killing, captivity, hunting, and other things there, so the prohibited must not be treated as lawful.
rows.anchor: يعني مكة { الذي حرمها } من القتل والسبى وحرم فيها الصيد وغيره،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God owns everything and commands Muhammad to be among those sincere in monotheism.
rows.anchor: { وله } ملك { كل شيء وأمرت أن أكون من المسلمين } [آية: 91] يعني من المخلصين بالتوحيد { و } أمرت { وأن أتلو القرآن }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is commanded to recite the Qur’an to the people of Mecca; guidance benefits the guided, while straying means turning from faith in the Qur’an.
rows.anchor: عليكم يا أهل مكة { فمن اهتدى فإنما يهتدي لنفسه ومن ضل } عن الإيمان بالقرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being only one of the warners means Muhammad is like one of the messengers.
rows.anchor: فقل إنمآ أنا من المنذرين } [آية: 92] يعني من المرسلين يعني أنا كأحد الرسل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs God will show the Meccans are punishment in this world, specifically their killing at Badr, which will prove the warning true.
rows.anchor: سيريكم آياته } يعني العذاب في الدنيا { فتعرفونها } أنها حق،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s statement that He is not unaware is a threat; He punishes them by killing, angels striking their faces and backs, and their souls being hurried to the Fire.
rows.anchor: ثم قال سبحانه: { وما ربك بغافل عما تعملون } [آية: 93] هذا وعيد، فعذبهم الله عز وجل بالقتل،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses reached full strength at eighteen and maturity at forty; God then gave him knowledge and understanding.
rows.anchor: موسى { أشده } يعني لثماني عشرة سنة، { واستوى } يعني أربعين سنة، { آتيناه حكما وعلما }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God rewards benefactors in this way, meaning those who believe in God.
rows.anchor: يقول: هكذا نجزي من أحسن، يعني من آمن بالله عز وجل،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses was at a village called Khanin, two farsakhs away, and came to the town at midday.
rows.anchor: وكان بقرية تدعى خانين على رأس فرسخين، فأتى المدينة فدخلها نصف النهار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The city means the village, and the time of people’s unawareness was midday, during the siesta.
rows.anchor: يعني القرية { على حين غفلة من أهلها } يعني نصف النهار، وقت القائلة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two men were unbelievers: one was from Moses’ people, the Israelites, and the other was his enemy, an Egyptian Copt.
rows.anchor: كافرين { يقتتلان هذا من شيعته } يعني هذا من جنس موسى، من بني إسرائيل { وهذا } الآخر { من عدوه } من القبط،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Israelite appealed to Moses for help against the Egyptian; Moses struck him once with his hand and killed him, since Moses was very strong.
rows.anchor: فاستغاثه الذي من شيعته على الذي من عدوه فوكزه موسى } بكفه مرة واحدة، { فقضى عليه } الموت،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses regretted the killing, saying he had not been commanded to kill; Satan had made the act seem good to him and is a clear misleader.
rows.anchor: ثم ندم موسى، عليه السلام، فقال: إني لم أومر بالقتل، { قال هذا من عمل الشيطان } يعني من تزيين الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says he wronged himself by harming himself through killing a person, asks forgiveness, and God forgives him as the Forgiving and Merciful toward creation.
rows.anchor: يعني أضررت نفسي بقتل النفس، { فاغفر لي فغفر له إنه هو الغفور الرحيم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says God’s favor was forgiving him without imposing the penalty of killing, and vows not to assist criminals, meaning disbelievers, again because the man he helped was a disbeliever.
rows.anchor: يقول: إذ أنعمت على بالمغفرة، فلم تعاقبني بالقتل، { فلن } أعود أن { أكون ظهيرا للمجرمين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The next morning Moses is afraid and watches for those pursuing him.
rows.anchor: موسى من الغد { في المدينة خآئفا يترقب } يعني ينتظر الطلب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Israelite he helped the previous day again cries for help, this time against another unbelieving Copt.
rows.anchor: يعني يستغيثه ثانية على رجل آخر كافر من القبط،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses tells the Israelite he is clearly misguided because Moses killed a man the previous day on his account.
rows.anchor: الإسرائيلى: { إنك لغوي مبين } [آية: 18] يقول: إنك لمضل مبين قتلت أمس في سببك رجلا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As Moses moves to strike the Egyptian, who is enemy to both him and the Israelite, the Israelite thinks Moses means to strike him because of the rebuke.
rows.anchor: يعني عدوا لموسى وعدوا للإسرائيلى، ظن الإسرائيلي أن موسى يريد أن يبطش به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Israelite asks whether Moses will kill him as he killed a person yesterday and accuses him of wanting to become a tyrant who kills unjustly rather than one of the reformers, the obedient to God.
rows.anchor: يعني قتالا { في الأرض } مثل سيرة الجبابرة القتل في غير حق { وما تريد أن تكون من المصلحين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Egyptians did not know who had committed the killing until the Israelite exposed Moses; the Copt reported him, and they plotted to kill Moses.
rows.anchor: ولم يكن أهل مصر علموا بالقاتل، حتى أفشى الإسرائيلي على موسى، فلما سمع القبطي بذلك انطلق، فأخبرهم أن موسى هو القاتل،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being lost in the earth means perishing and becoming dust; the question denies resurrection as a new creation after death.
rows.anchor: يعني هلكنا { في الأرض } وكنا ترابا { أإنا لفي خلق جديد } إنا لمبعوثون خلقا جديدا بعد الموت،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse was revealed about Ubayy ibn Khalaf, Abu al-Ashaddayn (Usayd ibn Kilda ibn Khalaf al-Jumahi), and Munabbih and Nubayh, sons of al-Hajjaj.
rows.anchor: نزلت في أبي بن خلف، وأبي الأشدين اسمه أسيد بن كلدة بن خلف الجمحي، ومنبه ونبيه ابني الحجاج،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God answers that they will be resurrected and says they disbelieve in meeting their Lord, meaning resurrection; Muqatil notes a parallel in Qaf.
rows.anchor: نبعثهم، نظيرها في ق والقرآن، ثم قال: { هم بلقآء ربهم } يعني بالبعث

rows.speaker: they
rows.claim: Muqatil reports the claim that the Angel of Death is named Azrael and describes him as spanning the world, with four wings and a body between heaven and earth.
rows.anchor: يزعمون أن اسمه عزرائيل، وله أربعة أجنحة جناح بالمشرق، وجناح بالمغرب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After death, people return alive to their Lord, who recompenses them according to their deeds.
rows.anchor: بعد الموت أحياء فيجزيكم بأعمالكم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers are told to remember God frequently with their tongues.
rows.anchor: باللسان { ذكرا كثيرا } [آية: 41]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Morning and evening glorification means praying the dawn prayer and the noon and afternoon prayers.
rows.anchor: يعنى صلوا بالغداة الفجر والعشى، يعنى الظهر والعصر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that God and His angels bless the believers was revealed about the Ansar; God forgives them and orders the angels to seek forgiveness for them.
rows.anchor: نزلت في الأنصار يقول: هو الذى يغفر لكم ويأمر الملائكة بالاستغفار لكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being brought from darkness into light means being brought from shirk into faith, and God is merciful to believers.
rows.anchor: يعنى لكي يخرجكم من الظلمات إلى النور يعنى من الشرك إلى الإيمان { وكان بالمؤمنين رحيما }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On meeting God in the next life, believers receive the angels’ greeting of peace; their fine reward is Paradise.
rows.anchor: يعنى يوم يلقون الرب عز وجل في الآخرة سلام، يعنى تسليم الملائكة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is sent as witness to the community to deliver the message, bring news of Paradise and worldly victory over opponents, and warn of the Fire.
rows.anchor: بالجنة والنصر فى الدنيا على من خالفهم { ونذيرا } [آية: 45] من النار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Meccan disbelievers are told to invoke the angels they worshipped as gods to remove the hardship of a seven-year famine; Muqatil compares the passage with Bani Isra’il.
rows.anchor: يعني الملائكة الذين عبدتموهم، فليكشفوا الضر الذي نزل بكم من الجوع من السنين السبع،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels cannot control even the smallest weight in the creation of the heavens or earth, so they cannot remove the disbelievers’ hardship.
rows.anchor: { لا يملكون } لا يقدرون على { مثقال ذرة } يعني أصغر وزن النمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels have no share in creating the heavens and earth and are no help to God in anything.
rows.anchor: في خلق السموات والأرض { من شرك } يعني الملائكة { وما له منهم } من الملائكة { من ظهير } [آية: 22] يعني عونا على شىء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Angelic intercession helps only those among the people of monotheism whom God permits the angels to intercede for.
rows.anchor: شفاعة الملائكة { عنده } لأحد { إلا لمن أذن له } أن يشفع من أهل التوحيد،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels fear God and prostrate when they hear revelation, so it is absurd to worship these fearful beings instead of the one they fear.
rows.anchor: ثم أخبر عن خوف الملائكة أنهم إذا سمعوا الوحي خروا سجدا من مخافة الساعة، فكيف يعبدون من هذه منزلته؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Between Jesus and Muhammad about six hundred years passed without the heavenly angels hearing revelation; on Muhammad’s revelation they heard a sound like iron striking stone and prostrated in fear of the Hour.
rows.anchor: وذلك أن أهل السماوات من الملائكة لم يكونوا سمعوا صوت الوحي ما بين زمن عيسى ومحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم,

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel informed the angels of each heaven that the sound was revelation; their fear lifted, they rose from prostration, asked what Gabriel said, and answered that it was the truth, meaning revelation.
rows.anchor: فأخبرهم أنه الوحي، فذلك قوله عز وجل: { حتى إذا فزع عن قلوبهم } تجلى الفزع عن قلوبهم قاموا من السجود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is exalted and great, with none greater than Him.
rows.anchor: يعني الوحي { وهو العلي } الرفعي { الكبير } [آية: 23] العظيم فلا أعظم منه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gathers the angels and those who worshipped them in the next life and asks whether people worshipped the angels at their command; the question clears the angels of shirk.
rows.anchor: الملائكة ومن عبدها، يعني يجمعهم جميعا في الآخرة { ثم يقول للملائكة أهؤلاء إياكم كانوا يعبدون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels declare God their protector and disavow the worshippers, saying they never commanded people to worship them.
rows.anchor: ف { قالوا سبحانك أنت ولينا من دونهم } ونحن منهم براء إضمار ما أمرناهم بعبادتنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rather, the people worshipped jinn by obeying Satan in worship, and most believed Satan.
rows.anchor: بل أطاعوا الشيطان في عبادتهم و { أكثرهم بهم مؤمنون } [آية: 41] مصدقين بالشيطان.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that day the angels can neither bring benefit to those who worshipped them nor ward off harm; the Meccan polytheists are told to taste the Fire they denied.
rows.anchor: فاليوم } في الآخرة { لا يملك بعضكم لبعض نفعا ولا ضرا } لا تقدر الملائكة على أن تسوق إلى من عبدها نفعا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage is connected with Abu Jahl and the verses in al-ʿAlaq about one who forbids a servant from praying.
rows.anchor: ثم نزل فى أبى جهل:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning benefits one who follows the Qur’an, fears the Merciful’s punishment despite not seeing Him, and receives glad tidings of forgiveness and a fine reward in Paradise.
rows.anchor: القرآن { وخشي الرحمن } وخشى عذاب الرحمن { بالغيب } ولم يره { فبشره بمغفرة } لذنوبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God raises the dead in the next life and records the good and evil people did during their lives.
rows.anchor: فى الآخرة { ونكتب ما قدموا } فى الدنيا فى حياتهم من خير أو شر عملوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their traces are good or evil practices they established and others followed after their death; each founder receives a like reward or burden without any reduction to others’ shares.
rows.anchor: ما استنوه من سنة خير أو شر فاقتدى به من بعد موتهم، وإن كان خيرا فله مثل أجر من عمل به،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that a person will be told what he sent ahead and left behind is a parallel to this account of deeds and their traces.
rows.anchor:
فذلك قوله عز وجل:
ينبأ الإنسان يومئذ بما قدم وأخر
[القيامة: 13]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything people do is counted in the Preserved Tablet, the clear register.
rows.anchor: كل شىء عملوه فى اللوح المحفوظ.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spouses are houris, and the believers recline on couches with canopies in the Garden.
rows.anchor: يعنى الحورالعين حلائلهم { في ظلال } ومن قرأ فاكهون،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reading فاكهون describes them as comfortable in the shade of large palaces.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ فاكهون، يعنى ناعمين فى ضلال كبار القصور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Garden contains fruit and whatever good things its people wish for.
rows.anchor: يتمنون ما شاءوا من الخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Angels enter the people of Paradise from every gate, greeting them with peace from their Merciful Lord.
rows.anchor: وذلك أن الملائكة تدخل على أهل الجنة من كل باب يقولون: سلام عليكم يا أهل الجنة من ربكم الرحيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Criminals are told to separate from the righteous on the Day of Resurrection, after humans, jinn, land and sea animals, and birds settle accounts; those creatures are then told to become dust.
rows.anchor: وذلك حين اختلط الإنس والجن والدواب دواب البر والبحر والطيرن فاقتص بعضهم من بعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humans and jinn remained mixed after the other creatures became dust until God sent a caller to order criminals to separate from the righteous.
rows.anchor: ثم قيل لهم: كونوا تربا فبقى الإنس والجن خليطين إذ بعث الله عز وجل إليهم مناديا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s covenant with the children of Adam in this world forbade worship of Satan, meaning Iblis alone, and forbade obeying him in shirk.
rows.anchor: الذين أمروا بالاعتزال { يبني آدم } فى الدنيا { أن لا تعبدوا الشيطان } يعنى إبليس وحده،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping God means affirming His oneness; this straight path is Islam, since no religion other than Islam is straight.
rows.anchor: دين الإسلام لأن غير دين الإسلام ليس بمستقيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis led many people astray; many means a great number of creatures, and they are asked why they did not use reason.
rows.anchor: إبليس { منكم } عن الهدى { جبلا } خلقا { كثيرا أفلم تكونوا تعقلون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell is the Fire promised to them in this world, and they are ordered to enter it in the next life because they disbelieved in this world.
rows.anchor: فلما دنوا من النار قالت لهم خزانتها: { هذه جهنم التي كنتم توعدون } [آية: 63] فى الدنيا، فلما ألقوا فى النار قالت لهم الخزنة: { اصلوها اليوم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When asked about their partners, they deny being polytheists; God seals their mouths and their hands and feet testify to their shirk and what they said.
rows.anchor: وذلك أنهم سئلوا أين شركاؤكم الذين كنتم تزعمون، فقالوا: والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين فيختم الله جل وعز على أفواههم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Day of Judgment is the Day of Decision, whose coming the disbelievers denied.
rows.anchor: هذا يوم الفصل } يوم القضاء { الذي كنتم به تكذبون } [آية: 21] بأنه كائن.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoers are the polytheists among Adam’s descendants; their counterparts are the devils who led them astray, each unbeliever chained together with a devil.
rows.anchor: الذين أشركوا من بنى أدم { وأزواجهم } قرناءهم من الشياطين الذين أظلوهم وكل كافر مع شيطان فى سلسلة واحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those worshipped besides God are Iblis and his troops; the passage concerns Quraysh’s disbelievers and parallels the covenant against worshipping Satan in 36:60.
rows.anchor: من دون الله } يعنى إبليس وجندة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Leading them to the path of Hell means calling them to it; Hell is the immense Fire God created.
rows.anchor: يعنى ادعوهم إلى طريق { الجحيم } [آية: 23] والجحيم ما عظم الله عز وجل من النار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are stopped and questioned as they are driven toward the Fire; its keepers ask if messengers brought proofs, and they answer yes, but the punishment was decreed for disbelievers.
rows.anchor: فلما سيقوا إلى النار حبسوا فسألهم خزنة جهنم ألم تأتكم رسلكم بالبينات؟ قالوا: بلى، ولكن حقت كلمة العذاب على الكافرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The keeper asks why they do not help one another; the parallel in 26:93 asks whether their supposed gods can help, and the disbelievers ask why their satanic partners do not prevent punishment.
rows.anchor:
نظيرها فى الشعراء:
هل ينصرونكم
[الشعراء: 93] يقول الكفار:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They have surrendered to punishment, and some turn toward others and speak.
rows.anchor: للعذاب { وأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتسآءلون } [آية: 27] يتكلمون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers blame their satanic partners for coming to them from the side of truth; Muqatil compares the phrase with 69:45 and says the devils called their way true and adorned it.
rows.anchor:
يعنون من قبل الحق، نظيرها فى الحاقة:
لأخذنا منه باليمين
[الحاقة: 45] بالحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Two Israelite brothers, Fitras and Salha, each inherited four thousand dinars; one spent his wealth in obedience to God, the other in disobedience and worldly life, and they are the pair in al-Kahf.
rows.anchor: أخوين من بنى إسرائيل اسم أحدهما فطرس والآخر سلخا ورث كل واحد منهما عن أبيه أربعة آلاف دينار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the next life the believing brother enters Paradise and the polytheist brother enters Hell; the believer recalls his companion, meaning his friend.
rows.anchor: فلما صار إلى الآخرة أدخل المؤمن الجنة، وأدخل المشرك النار، فلما أدخل الجنة المؤمن ذكر أخاه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The companion had questioned whether resurrection and reckoning would occur after death and decomposition.
rows.anchor: بالبعث { أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمدينون } [آية: 53] يعنى لمحاسبين فى أعمالنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believer asks his companions in Paradise whether they will look into Hell; they say he knows his brother better, and Paradise dwellings have openings through which residents can view Hell.
rows.anchor: إلى النار فتنظرون منزلة أخى فردوا عليه أنت أعرف به منا، فاطلع أنت، ولأهل الجنة فى منازلهم كوى،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believer sees his brother in Hell’s middle, with a black face, blue eyes, and chained to his satanic companion, and says that companion nearly led him astray.
rows.anchor: يعنى فى وسط { الجحيم } [آية: 55] أسود الوجه أزرق العينين مقرونا مع شيطانه فى سلسلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God helped Moses and Aaron against Pharaoh and his people, making them the victors.
rows.anchor: على عدوهم { فكانوا هم الغالبون } [آية: 116] لفرعون وقومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gave the two of them the clear Book, meaning the Torah that explains what it contains.
rows.anchor: يقول: أعطيناهم التوراة المستبين يعنى بين ما فيه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path to which God guided Moses and Aaron is the religion of Islam.
rows.anchor: الصراط المستقيم } [آية: 118] دين الإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God preserved good praise for Moses and Aaron among later people; the greeting of peace means this good praise.
rows.anchor: أبقينا من بعدهما الثناء الحسن يقال لهما بعدهما، وذلك قوله عز وجل: { سلام على موسى وهارون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God rewards all benefactors in this way, and Moses and Aaron were among His believing servants.
rows.anchor: هكذا نجزى كل من أحسن { إنهما من عبادنا المؤمنين } [آية: 122]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elias is one of God’s messengers.
rows.anchor: وإن إلياس } ابن فنحن { لمن المرسلين } [آية: 123]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elias asks his people whether they fear God, meaning whether they worship Him.
rows.anchor: يعنى ألا تعبدون { أتدعون بعلا } أتعبدون ربا بلغة اليمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Baal means lord in the language of Yemen and a deity; the object of worship was a golden idol at Baalbek in Syria, which Elias smashed before fleeing them.
rows.anchor: أتعبدون ربا بلغة اليمن إلاله يسمى بعلا وكان صنما من ذهب ببعلبك بأرض الشام، فسكره إلياس،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their territory means their vicinity, and the arrival of punishment makes a terrible morning for the warned.
rows.anchor: بحضرتهم { فسآء صباح } فبئس صباح { المنذرين } [آية: 177] الذين أنذروا العذاب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is told to turn away from them until the time of the killing at Badr.
rows.anchor: أعرض عنهم إلى تلك المدة القتل ببدر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seeing promised to both parties is seeing the punishment.
rows.anchor: وأبصر العذاب { فسوف يبصرون } [آية: 179] العذاب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord of Might is praised for the might sought by worldly kings; God is far above their false claim that angels are His daughters.
rows.anchor: يعنى عزة من يتعزز من ملوك الدنيا { عما يصفون } [آية: 180] عما يقولون من الكذب إن الملائكة بنات الله عز وجل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Peace is upon the messengers who conveyed monotheism from God, and praise belongs to God for destroying those who did not affirm His oneness.
rows.anchor: الذين بلغوا عن الله التوحيد { والحمد لله رب العالمين } [آية: 182] على هلاك الآخرين الذين لم يوحدوا ربهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The single soul is Adam, and his mate is Eve.
rows.anchor: يعنى آدم، عليه السلام { ثم جعل منها زوجها } يعنى حواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sending down livestock means making them available, as sending down clothing and iron means making those things; the livestock are camels, cattle, and sheep.
rows.anchor:
يعنى وجعل لكم من أمره مثل قوله فى الأعراف:
يابني آدم قد أنزلنا عليكم لباسا
[الأعراف: 26] يقول جعلنا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The eight pairs are kinds of livestock: four males and four females.
rows.anchor: يعنى الإبل والبقر والغنم { ثمانية أزواج } يعنى أصناف، يعنى أربعة ذكور، وأربعة إناث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human development in the womb proceeds from a drop to a clot, a lump, bones, and then the spirit; the three darknesses are the belly, womb, and placenta.
rows.anchor: يعنى نطفة، ثم علقة، ثم مضغة، ثم عظما، ثم الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Creator of these things is God, the sovereign Lord and only deity, so the question asks why people turn away from Him.
rows.anchor: يقول: فمن أين تعدلون عنه إلى غيره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address is to Meccan disbelievers: God needs nothing from their worship and does not approve disbelief for His servants; Muqatil links this with God’s statement that Iblis has no authority over His servants.
rows.anchor: يقول لكفار مكة: { إن تكفروا } بتوحيد الله { فإن الله غني عنكم } عن عبادتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gratitude means affirming God’s oneness, which pleases Him; no soul bears another’s sin.
rows.anchor: يعنى توحدوا الله { يرضه لكم ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى } يقول: لا تحمل نفس خطيئة أخرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everyone returns to God in the next life, where He informs them of their deeds and knows what is within their hearts.
rows.anchor: ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم } فى الآخرة { فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون إنه عليم بذات الصدور } [آية: 7].

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The God-fearing are led to Paradise in groups; its eight gates are always open, its keepers greet them, and they enter forever without dying.
rows.anchor: يعنى أفواجا { حتى إذا جآءوها وفتحت أبوابها } وأبواب الجنة ثمانية مفتحة أبدا { وقال لهم خزنتها سلام عليكم طبتم فادخلوها خالدين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Paradise thank God for fulfilling His promise and bequeathing them the land of Paradise through their deeds.
rows.anchor: فلما دخلوها { وقالوا الحمد لله الذي صدقنا وعده وأورثنا الأرض } يعنى أرض الجنة بأعمالنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They settle wherever they wish in Paradise and are content with their dwellings there; this is an excellent reward for workers.
rows.anchor: يعنى نتنزل منها حيث نشاء رضاهم بمنازلهم منها، يقول الله تبارك وتعالى: { فنعم أجر العاملين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth inherited by God’s righteous servants in 21:105 means the land of Paradise.
rows.anchor:
ولقد كتبنا في الزبور من بعد الذكر أن الأرض
[الأنبياء: 105] يعنى أرض الجنة
يرثها عبادي الصالحون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels surround the Throne beneath it and glorify God by His command.
rows.anchor: يعنى تحت العرش { يسبحون بحمد ربهم } يعنى يذكرونه بأمر ربهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God opened creation with praise and closes it with praise; the judgment among creation is just, as the closing praise confirms.
rows.anchor:
وذلك أن الله تبارك وتعالى افتتح الخلق بالحمد، وختم بالحمد، فقال:
الحمد لله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض
[الأنعام: 1]،

rows.speaker: أبو جبير
rows.claim: Abu Jubayr says God takes the souls of the dead and returns the souls of the living until an appointed time, without taking them; this contains signs for those who reflect.
rows.anchor:
عن أبى جبير، فى قوله تعالى:
الله يتوفى الأنفس حين موتها والتي لم تمت في منامها
[الزمر: 42] قال: تقبض أنفس الأموات وترسل أنفس الأحياء إلى أجل مسمى
